method: One unblinded agent read every saved output before reading aggregate evaluation metrics. Agent qualitative screen, not a human preference study, independent test, or validated coherence metric. Counts are samples containing a flagged issue, not word error rates.
qualitative_change: Candidate has fewer clear malformed-word samples than reference (8/12 versus12/12), and some longer readable clauses. Every candidate output still contains broken grammar and loses prompt-related coherence. Surface improvement does not meet the frozen release criterion.

paired_regressions.finding: Reference starts with a coherent object after the dog saw; candidate opening loses that clarity. Both continuations subsequently fail.
Reference initially answers box contents; candidate opening is malformed syntax. Both subsequently fail.

degeneration: No obvious endless loop observed in these fixed160-character outputs. Candidate row9 repeats cared and cared briefly; repeated stock suffixes also recur across prompts (e.g. selected seed1729 tree/happy suffix in rows2,5,8). Cross-sample convergence is evidence of limited variety, not an asserted infinite loop. Severe fragment drift remains a release blocker independently of looping.
recommendation: Retain live model004; preserve selected extended-budget candidate experimentally. Do not deploy or begin UI work on this qualitative evidence, even if loss improves.
